name: Anti-Drug Misuse and Abuse Program (ADMAP)
description:
The Anti-Drug Misuse and Abuse Program (ADMAP) Committee is dedicated to advocating against drug misuse and abuse while promoting a healthier, safer, and drug-misuse-free society. Within PANS, the committee raises awareness among PANSites and the wider community about the dangers and consequences of drug misuse, encouraging responsible medication use and informed health decisions.

ADMAP contributes to PANS by advancing public health education and empowering PANSites to become advocates for responsible medication practices. Through sustained education, advocacy, and collective action, the committee aims to expand its reach and foster a well-informed society where drug misuse and abuse are prevented and their harmful effects reduced.
activities: Educational programmes
Awareness campaigns
Community outreach
Its flagship rallies
Collaboration with healthcare professionals, organisations and stakeholders to support its advocacy

name: Content Committee
description:
The Content Committee is the voice of the organization. We plan, create, and publish the stories, updates, and resources that keep our members and followers engaged across our website and social media. Our work includes writing articles and newsletters, designing graphics, managing social media calendars, and capturing event highlights.

At the end of the session, we have a specially curated magazine by name "RECIPHARM", highlighting the innovations, creativity and milestones of the pharmacy profession. Stay tuned!
activities: Planning, creating, and publishing stories, updates, and resources across the website and social media
Writing articles and newsletters
Designing graphics and managing social media calendars
Capturing event highlights
plans: Publishing the annual RECIPHARM magazine at the end of the session, highlighting innovations, creativity, and milestones in pharmacy

name: Media Committee
description:
Ever laughed at funny videos and beautiful pictures of PANSITES? That's the Media Committee showing workings. We capture memorable moments, events, and significant milestones within the association, giving members a glimpse of the people, experiences, and activities that make PANS-UNILAG what it is.

Where words alone may not do justice, this team tells the story through pictures, videos, and other forms of media, ensuring that our activities are seen, shared, and remembered.
activities: Capturing memorable moments, events, and significant milestones within the association
Creating engaging video content and photography of PANS activities
Documenting student life, experiences, and milestone events across the faculty
Ensuring association activities are seen, shared, and remembered through digital media
plans: Expanding multimedia event coverage and creative video storytelling across association platforms

name: Design Committee
description:
From the beautiful flyers announcing upcoming events to the creative, eye-catching publicity materials and designs you see across our social media platforms, the individuals behind these visuals are the Design Committee.

We bring ideas to life through creativity, transforming information into appealing designs that capture attention and communicate effectively. From event promotions to announcements and other official materials, we help give PANS-UNILAG activities a distinct visual identity.
activities: Designing creative, eye-catching event announcement flyers and publicity materials
Creating visual assets and promotional graphics for social media platforms
Developing official materials, announcements, and branding for association activities
Transforming information into engaging visual designs that communicate effectively
plans: Maintaining and elevating the distinct visual identity of PANS-UNILAG across all media

name: PANS Public Health Team
description:
The PANS Public Health Team (PPHT) is a subsidiary of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, dedicated to promoting public health awareness, disease prevention, and community well-being through health education, medical outreaches, and public health campaigns.

Through its initiatives, PPHT provides pharmacy students with opportunities to apply their knowledge beyond the classroom, develop practical public health skills, engage with communities, and understand the pharmacist’s role in promoting public health. Members contribute through project planning, research, health education, logistics, partnerships, and documentation, fostering teamwork and community service.

PPHT welcomes pharmacy students who want to explore opportunities beyond academics, develop practical skills, and make a positive impact on society. At PPHT, there’s room for every pharmacy student who wants to do more than just academics. There’s a place for you.
activities: The medical outreach component of PANS Health Week
The Know Your Drug series
World Malaria Day activities
Awareness campaigns commemorating global health days
achievements: Sexual and Reproductive Health Awareness Day 2026
World Antimicrobial Awareness Day, organised in collaboration with other PANS committees and student organisations
plans: Strengthen existing initiatives
Expand collaborations
Create more opportunities for students to take part in meaningful public health activities and improve community health outcomes

name: Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Committee
description:
The Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Committee of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, promotes awareness and implementation of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals through advocacy, health education, community service, and sustainable development initiatives.

Through its initiatives, it encourages PANSites to embrace social responsibility and contribute to sustainable development within and beyond the university community. Guided by the principle “From Awareness to Action, From Service to Impact,” the committee remains committed to turning awareness into meaningful community impact.
activities: SDG awareness campaigns
Environmental projects
Community health outreaches
Collaborative initiatives addressing social and health-related challenges
achievements: A collaborative Women’s Day awareness initiative
plans: The Campus Challenge
Maternal health outreaches
Community health and sanitation awareness walks
Interactive SDG learning sessions
motto: From Awareness to Action, From Service to Impact

name: PANS Research Club
description:
The PANS Research Club of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, is dedicated to developing research knowledge, practical skills, and critical thinking among pharmacy students from the early stages of their academic journey.

Through its initiatives, the PANS Research Club seeks to foster a research-oriented mindset among pharmacy students, encouraging scientific inquiry, innovation, and the development of meaningful solutions to challenges in pharmacy and healthcare.
activities: Research methodology and scientific writing training
Journal reviews
Knowledge-sharing sessions
Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD) training, in collaboration with the Faculty of Pharmacy Computational Research Unit (FAPCRU)
achievements: Practical CADD training opportunities, also extended to PANSites beyond the club
plans: A research conference
Preparing final-year students for undergraduate research projects
More practical research opportunities
Encouraging student-led publications

name: Career and Professional Development & Capacity Building Committee
description:
The Career and Professional Development (CPD) & Capacity Building Committee (CBC) of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, prepares pharmacy students for life beyond the classroom by promoting career development, practical skills, mentorship, and access to professional opportunities. Formed through the merger of two committees, it combines career guidance with capacity building to help PANSites make informed decisions about their professional journeys.

Through its initiatives, CPD & CBC seeks to equip PANSites with the skills, guidance, and confidence to pursue opportunities and navigate their professional journeys successfully.
achievements: The Japa Programme: a webinar on international study opportunities, scholarships, research and professional practice for pharmacists
plans: Career exploration sessions
Internship preparation
Mentorship programmes
Public speaking and pitching training
Practical support with CV writing, LinkedIn optimisation and applications
The PANS Opportunities Hub for sharing scholarships, internships and other opportunities
A Skills Library of useful resources and training materials
Stronger connections between students, alumni and industry professionals

name: Academics Committee
description: The Academic Committee supports the learning and academic development of students. We organize study sessions, tutorials, and share resources that help members grow academically and professionally. We also work to connect students with opportunities and show their prowess through competitions, research, and career development.
activities: Organizing study sessions and tutorials for pharmacy students
Sharing academic resources to support learning and professional growth
Connecting students with academic competitions, research, and career development opportunities
Providing academic orientation and guidance for incoming pharmacy students
plans: Expanding peer tutorials, study resources, and academic support initiatives across all levels

name: PANS Alumni Network Committee
description:
The Alumni and Network Committee of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, is dedicated to building and maintaining cordial, lasting relationships between PANS-UNILAG and its alumni for the mutual benefit of both parties.

As a newly established committee, its initial focus is to create effective communication channels that keep alumni connected to the association and encourage their involvement in PANS activities, making it easier for PANS to connect with former members and benefit from their experience, support, and contributions.
plans: Effective communication channels that keep alumni connected to the association
Alumni involvement in PANS activities
A strong alumni network in which graduates remain connected as ambassadors of PANS, sharing their experiences and supporting the association’s growth

name: International Pharmaceutical Students’ Federation (IPSF) UNILAG
description:
The International Pharmaceutical Students’ Federation (IPSF) Committee of the Pharmaceutical Association of Nigeria Students (PANS), University of Lagos, promotes awareness of IPSF and its programmes, connecting PANSites with international opportunities in pharmacy, professional development, and public health.

Through these efforts, the IPSF Committee seeks to help PANSites become informed, globally minded pharmacy students equipped to learn, collaborate, and contribute to the advancement of pharmacy and public health.
activities: Promoting the IPSF Student Exchange Programme
Sharing educational and scientific resources
Professional development opportunities
Relevant public health campaigns
plans: Increase IPSF awareness
Encourage participation in international exchange programmes
Strengthen knowledge sharing
Expand student engagement with the global pharmaceutical community
